items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I tell you who he had in that band. We had a guy named Curl, trumpet player

ctx.x: They solos in the, in Presbyterian church every Sunday for 5 dollars, you know. I used to do that also, see, a little contact. And after a couple of years I got all kinds of, I got these pupils, you know, see. And the contact and a pupils, lot of came from my brother's working with these musicians. Then from, then - and then I worked with the, Skinny Johnson, one of the greatest piano players me, I've ever heard, see. Then finally, after working around in these gigs in Boston, I was gettin' a little established,…
